recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Any future adjustment to the TestPlan scenario or nesting model should be made in HL7/fhir-testing-ig rather than in the core FHIR repository.
issue_request: FHIR-46628 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by FHIR-I. It requested a scenario-style hierarchy between TestPlan and TestCase, with the approved resolution to add recursive TestPlan.testCase.testCase content that breaks a larger test case into smaller components.
initial_application: Commit 543eee22a7169a6e942355e2ad55be9b6338cd56 added TestPlan.testCase.testCase with contentReference to #TestPlan.testCase in source/testplan/structuredefinition-TestPlan.xml, and PR HL7/fhir#3322 merged the TestPlan updates in commit 7e3300d58765ec86b043a759cf66bf31dab94419.
additional_context: FHIR-50901 later made a broader Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to replace the insufficient TestPlan design with a TestCases-derived structure. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestPlan, TestReport, and TestScript from active core source. Current source/fhir.ini has no active TestPlan build entry and points to the FHIR Testing IG; current core narrative links TestPlan to that external IG, whose TestPlan source contains the suite/test/nested-suite structure.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The audit commit records that there is no current source/testplan build input in this checkout and that reintroducing the deleted recursive TestPlan.testCase.testCase element would conflict with the later redesign and externalization.

related_jiras.note: Broader Applied/Persuasive TestPlan rework that superseded the earlier recursive testCase shape and is already represented on the combined branch.
